chat.t: [Breaking News] Massive discount event at the Donut House!
Eat and trigger special effects! The life-changing donut!
Infused with the latest technology! The grand release of the special "Stealth Donut"!
A flavor that can never be detected...! A taste that will never be discovered...!
It doesn't even leave fingerprints thanks to a special coating, so it's perfectly safe!
Do you have someone you must absolutely hide from right now?
Or are you being chased by the police?
Don't worry! This donut will solve everything in one shot!
Of course! It's a taste certified by the police!
Visit the Donut House today and get a free tasting!
Kihihit♡
Kihihit♡ Thanks to you, I hit record sales!
They even said it was deeply moving!
Keep up the good work in the future too♡

o: You want me to keep doing this in the future?!

chat.t: Did you think I'd stop with just this?
There's no way I'd just let a clueless, pathetic♡ sucker like you go♡ Serve me 'til you're worn to a frazzle♡
...Until this great Marcia is completely satisfied, that is! Kihihit♡

lines.t: In front of Donut House
It's clearly a lie. There's no way such a thing exists.
But I decided to check it out anyway, just in case.
Kihihit♡ It's a miracle donut! A life-changing taste! Just try one!
Wait... Is that...?
Feeling a sense of dread, I checked my phone... The one who sent the MochiTalk message is the cop who arrested me!
Dammit, why am I only realizing this now?
Just as I was about to slip away...
Ah! He's running away!
Whoa!
Kihihit♡ Why are you so startled? Are you scared of me?
Running away just from seeing Marcia, you really are a pathetic loser♡
Besides, why are you wearing a mask? Mmm...?
Hmmm... Hmmmm... This face...
(...Dammit, did she recognize me?!)
You have a pretty decent face!
(...What? Is she pretending not to notice on purpose?)
Now, what do you think now that you've taken off your mask? Doesn't it smell sweet?
It smells great... but I'm actually not a big fan of donuts...
Well, see ya!
Hmmm... So that's how you want to play it?
That's the wrong way! The place a pathetic escaped convict♡ belongs is back in prison!
...Cut me some slack, just this once.
Like hell I would! To fall for such obvious bait, you're worse than a pathetic fish♡ Apologize to fishermen everywhere♡
Don't tell me... that MochiTalk message was from you?!
Kihihit...♡
You caught me.
A taste that lets you lift buildings! Power Donut! A taste that makes you fast as light! Speed Donut!
A taste that heals all your wounds! Healing Donut! A taste that makes you vanish from the world! Stealth Donut!
Of course, the donuts don't actually do any of that, but nothing beats it as a marketing slogan!
You totally baited me!
Honestly, I never expected a pathetic loser♡ to actually fall for something like this!
(Can't be helped. Since it's come to this...)
(It's do or die!)
Seeing how you have to rely on such childish spam MochiTalk messages...
You must not have much confidence in your donuts, huh?
...Huhhhhh? What did you just say?
If that's not it, then prove it. Because if you can't, I'll go to prison and badmouth your donuts to everyone.
Kihihit♡ Fine. I'll let you taste it right now—my lovely donut!
Here! Say ahhh♡
M-Mph!
Though I was flustered, I took a slow bite, and sweetness immediately filled my mouth.
...I'll admit it. Your donuts are really delicious.
Kihihit♡ Admitting defeat already? Your sense of taste is pathetic too♡
Tch... Fine. Just make sure to bring me these donuts in prison. They're definitely delicious, at least.
Mmm... What should I do?
Ah! I have an even better idea! I should use you as our shop's promotional ambassador!
...What are you talking about?
If we say you broke out of prison because you missed our donuts so much, we can advertise them as '<bouten>donuts so good, you'd break out of prison for them</bouten>'!
No other donut in the world has a title like that! That means our donuts will have a one-of-a-kind title!
Kihihit♡ Our sales are going to skyrocket!
No, what on earth does that even...
(Wait, isn't this a chance? Maybe I won't have to go to prison?)
...Heh. That's a great proposal.
I knew you'd say that!
So, for today at least, I can easily...
Mmm...? Just for today?
What are you talking about? Obviously, it'll be until Marcia is fully satisfied!
Huh?
Alright, let's get right to it! Kihihit♡

And just like that, I was dragged away to be worked to the bone
as Donut House's promotional ambassador...
From what I heard, Donut House recorded its highest sales in recent memory that day...

chat.t: Mr. Ambassador! Shouldn't you be at work?
It's time to tell everyone how hard you struggled just to buy our donuts!
Give them a touching, tear-jerking epic!

o: ...Can't you just send me to prison instead?

chat.t: Mmm...? What are you talking about?
Thinking of running away already, you pathetic♡ prison-loving loser?♡ Go apologize to the Panoticon Maids!♡

o: I'm telling you, just lock me up in prison!!
I want to stop repeating "I love donuts so much!♡ Donuts are the best!" 100 times!!

chat.t: Kihihit♡
Kihihit♡ Sold out again today!
By the way... you were much better at it than last time.
Has your love for donuts grown that much?

o: I just want to stop and go to prison...

chat.t: Giving up already? Your love for donuts is seriously lacking.
You're so weak-willed♡!
Marcia is still far from fully satisfied, so keep up the good work!

lines.t: In front of Donut House
When I arrived, Marcia was in a standoff with some group. Wait, are those maids?
Did I hear that correctly? You won't give us <bouten>even a single</bouten> donut?
Why is that? Even when we're offering to pay dozens of times the original price!
Our... Master... wants... All of today's donuts...!
So... hand them over right now...! If you don't... we'll get in trouble...!
Oh my? How many times do I have to say it for you to understand?
I told you, just line up over there and buy them normally!
Marcia, what's going on here?
Ah, Mr. Ambassador! You're late for work♡ Go apologize to HR, you payroll thief!♡
Wait, that person is...
An... escaped prisoner...!
Kihihit♡ You sure are a celebrity!
Now, Mr. Ambassador. Explain to this dummy Maid why you escaped♡
I broke out! To eat! Donuts! And of course! I lined up properly! To buy them!
Kihihit♡ See? You heard him, Maid?
Ugh... Then we have no choice.
We didn't want... to resort to this...!
Oh my? What do you think you're trying to do?
Do you even know where you are right now?
Huh? Do you think this donut shop is some big deal?
Just because it's known... in Vermont... Are you bragging...?!
Sigh... Did you really think Donut House was just a donut shop?
(...Wait, it wasn't?!)
They say there was an old saying...
If you're ever being chased by someone, no.matter.what. you must find '<bouten>the place with donuts</bouten>'!
Because that's the safest place in the world!
Which means this place... is a safe haven for anyone!
To think you Maids were such dummies♡ that you didn't even know something so basic...
Alright! I'll show you exactly what kind of place Donut House is! Kihihit♡
Kihihit♡ Are you awake now, dummy Maid?♡
I could throw you into prison right now, but...
Since you're still customers who wanted our donuts...
Here! I'll let you have a taste! Say ahhh!
Mmph?! W-Wait, why'd you shove a donut in my mouth...? Ah... It's so delicious...
H-Gasp! The sweetness... is spreading throughout my entire body... Hwaaa...
If you want more, line up nicely! Kihihit♡
...Yes. For a donut this good, it's definitely worth waiting in line!
Hehe... This is heaven...
Kihihit♡ Another case solved!
No bad behavior is tolerated at Donut House!
How surprising. You're actually acting like a proper police officer for once.
Huh? What did you think I was?
I'm actually a high-performing officer, you know!
You actually look somewhat reliable now.
Well, that's only natural for Marcia!
Ahem! Anyway, since you worked hard, you pathetic♡ loser... here! Say ahhh♡
Mmm... It's still incredibly delicious.
Kihihit♡ Of course it is!
Always delicious, no matter when you eat it! That's our goal!
And everyone should be able to buy them fairly.
That's a nice thought. I'll promote it on my way back.
Huh? On your way back? To where?
Uh, home, obviously...
What are you saying? Your work has only just begun!
Make sure to do your absolute best to promote us today too!
Ah... No way!!
Don't tell me you're tired already?
Pathetic♡ I'm not letting you go until we sell out♡ Go apologize to all the waiting donuts!♡
And so, I kept chanting my promotional slogan until the donuts were completely sold out...

chat.t: Congratulations, Mr. Ambassador!
The moment has finally come!

o: Could it be?! Are you finally satisfied?!

chat.t: Mmm...? No way.
Today marks our very first off-site promotional campaign!
This means we can spread the word about our donuts even further!
How about it? Feel motivated yet? Kihihit♡
Mr. Ambassador, about today...
I'll say you've barely checked off the first box of my satisfaction.
You did pretty well for a pathetic♡ loser♡

o: ...Please, just send me back to prison.

chat.t: I'm never letting you go♡
Remember, you have to keep promoting until Marcia is fully, completely satisfied!
Kihihit♡

lines.t: Somewhere in Humanitas
I arrived where Marcia told me to meet her. But this place is... Don't tell me...
Alright! Today's promotional target is...
Drumroll, please!
Ta-da!
Isn't this... the Fit Angels' Hideout?!
Kihihit♡ Correct!
We're going to run an intense promotional campaign here today!
It's time to show off what you're truly capable of!
Besides, it's our first off-site campaign, so aren't you super excited?
...Don't the Fit Angels hate donuts?
Exactly! Kihihit♡
Those pathetic losers who don't even know the taste of donuts♡ Choke on your protein donuts, you protein-obsessed junkies!♡
So today, your job is to turn the Fit Angels into '<bouten>Donut Angels</bouten>'!
Are you trying to get me killed?!
Ke! Ton! Ke! Ton!
Oh, are you looking to join our gym?
Wait, you are...
Hello, muscle brain losers♡ How have you been?
Since you never visited, I decided to come to you myself!♡
You... donut demon! Why are you here!
Mmm, I wonder?
Let's just say I suddenly felt like feeding you some donuts.
Kihihit♡ I came to save you poor, pathetic losers♡ who don't even know what donuts taste like.
Don't try to seduce us with that sweet... I mean, horrible smell!
Yeah! You have no idea how hard we've trained all this time!
Yeah, yeah. You said the same thing last time.
But the reason you became Keton and Sucra in the first place...
Was because you tasted our donuts, wasn't it?
And now you're trying to steel yourselves because you know you can't quit!
(Sh-She's a demon...)
We won't fall for it as easily as before!!
Let's go! Let's show them the power of our Keton and Sucra training!
Alright! I'll fill you up with sugar from head to toe! Kihihit♡
Damn it... The smell is draining all my strength...
I can't believe this... This is so frustrating...
Are we really forced to eat that horrible thing like this...!
Collapsing already? Pathetic♡ Go apologize to your overworked kidneys, you protein-obsessed freak!♡
No... That... That can't happen...!
Get up... I must get up...! I will show that donut demon our Will...!
Fit Angels, wait a second.
If you keep going like this, you'll never beat her.
?! What do you mean by that!
You've been possessed by that demon too! Or did you become her slave?
...Ahem. You're half-right, but... anyway, let me teach you how to prevent muscle loss.
Just eat the donut.
W-What?! Are you telling me to fall from grace?!
You absolute devil! Do you have any idea how hard I've worked to hold out until now?! Huh?!
Did you know? Donuts actually pack an insane amount of energy.
They lift your mood, give you vitality... and for guys like you, they grant one more special power.
The power of Forbidden Pleasure.
?! Forbidden Pleasure...?
With sweet talk like that... Ugh, sugar is absolutely forbidden...
So wouldn't it be better to just eat your fill, and use the built-up guilt from that Forbidden Pleasure to work out even harder?
Even wasting time worrying like this is causing you muscle loss, isn't it?
Th-That... is hard to deny...
Ugh... He's right... Doing even one more set during this time would be...!
Kihihit♡ Have you completely given up on thinking now?
Even your brain muscles are pickled in sugar♡ Pathetic insulin♡ Go drown in hyperglycemia!♡
M-Mph...! No...! Ah... Ahhh... This taste...
Ah... It's delicious...
As the Fit Angels began to eat the donuts... they all showed expressions of pure bliss.
Kihihit♡ Game over!
Splendid job, Mr. Ambassador! That was a much bigger contribution than I expected.
They're already eating several boxes of donuts...
See? Gaining customers like this is incredibly reassuring, you know?
Now you know why I insisted on coming all the way here!
It was certainly a fun challenge. And we got results, too.
How about it? Are you satisfied today?
Well, um, anyway... i-it wasn't bad...! Ki-Kihihit...♡
But you're still far from done, I'm not satisfied yet, and we still have sales goals to meet...
Marcia has no intention of letting a pathetic♡ loser go over just this!
Pathetic♡ Pathetic♡ You're Marcia's personal doormat♡ Dummy, dummy, dummy!♡
I followed Marcia, whose cheeks were unusually red, back to the Donut House...
Of course, afterward, I was worked to the bone by Marcia, who was in an exceptionally high-spirited mood...
